# AwesomeCUA

> Source-backed catalog of computer-use, GUI, browser and mobile agents: 3,919 curated resources (1,673 papers and surveys, 2,246 models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, tools and products), each reviewed against a primary source with evidence, review dates and separate license declarations. 453 metadata-only bibliography records await relevance review and are labeled separately.

Code, data, weights and document licenses are separate. Every resource, category, topic and research-library page has a Markdown version at `index.md` beside it, and every resource page its complete record at `record.json`.

## Catalog by kind

- [Models and checkpoints](https://awesomecua.com/categories/model/index.md): 124 curated records
- [Datasets](https://awesomecua.com/categories/dataset/index.md): 99 curated records
- [Benchmarks](https://awesomecua.com/categories/benchmark/index.md): 217 curated records
- [Agents](https://awesomecua.com/categories/agent/index.md): 316 curated records
- [Frameworks](https://awesomecua.com/categories/framework/index.md): 580 curated records
- [Infrastructure](https://awesomecua.com/categories/infrastructure/index.md): 55 curated records
- [Tools](https://awesomecua.com/categories/tool/index.md): 809 curated records
- [Products](https://awesomecua.com/categories/product/index.md): 20 curated records
- [Publishers](https://awesomecua.com/categories/company/index.md): 16 curated records
- [Learning resources](https://awesomecua.com/categories/learning/index.md): 10 curated records
- [Surveys](https://awesomecua.com/categories/survey/index.md): 28 curated records
- [Research papers](https://awesomecua.com/categories/paper/index.md): 1,645 curated records; listed 60 per page in the research library below

## Static API

Versioned JSON and CSV under https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/; every file carries `version` and `generated_at`.

- [API documentation](https://awesomecua.com/api/index.md): endpoints, fields, review states and versioning
- [API index](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/index.json): endpoint list with counts, byte sizes and SHA-256
- [JSON Schema](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/schema.json)
- [resources.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/resources.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/resources.csv)): Curated resources other than papers: models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, infrastructure, tools, products, publishers and learning resources.
- [papers.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/papers.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/papers.csv)): Curated research papers and surveys, with authors, recorded publication dates, arXiv versions and citation files.
- [categories.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/categories.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/categories.csv)): Resource kinds and research topics with curated counts and links to their pages, Markdown and data.
- [changes.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/changes.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/changes.csv)): Catalog events in the 30 days before the snapshot: editorial reviews, new bibliography records and scope exclusions.
- [candidates.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/candidates.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/candidates.csv)): UNREVIEWED rows, clearly flagged: bibliography records awaiting relevance review and discovered identifiers awaiting any review. Not part of the curated catalog.

## Agent and RAG access

```sh
git clone https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-CUA.git
```

- [Agent instructions](https://awesomecua.com/AGENTS.md)
- [Human and agent guide](https://awesomecua.com/agents/)
- [中文指南](https://awesomecua.com/zh/agents/)
- [Reviewed retrieval documents](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/rag-documents.jsonl)
- [All retrieval documents](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/rag-all-records.jsonl)
- [Export manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/rag-manifest.json)
- [Full catalog JSONL](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/catalog.jsonl): every active record, including metadata-only ones

## Guides and policies

- [What are computer-use agents?](https://awesomecua.com/guides/what-are-computer-use-agents/): Understand the observe–plan–act loop, how GUI agents differ from browser automation, and which research resources help you get started.
- [How to choose a GUI-agent benchmark](https://awesomecua.com/guides/gui-agent-benchmarks/): Compare desktop task execution, browser workflows, mobile environments, and GUI grounding, and preserve the evaluation conditions needed for meaningful comparisons.
- [Where to find training data for GUI agents](https://awesomecua.com/guides/gui-agent-training-data/): Distinguish grounding examples, interaction trajectories, screen understanding data, and benchmark tasks, with primary dataset sources and separate licensing checks.
- [Editorial policy](https://awesomecua.com/about/): review states, inclusion boundary and corrections
- [Coverage ledger](https://awesomecua.com/coverage/): source populations and known gaps
- [Catalog updates](https://awesomecua.com/updates/): scan schedule and the latest completed scan

## Optional

- [Complete curated catalog in one file](https://awesomecua.com/llms-full.txt): every curated record once, compactly; full annotations are in the per-kind files above
- [Atom feed](https://awesomecua.com/feed.xml) and [JSON Feed](https://awesomecua.com/feed.json): the 100 newest reviewed resources
- [Benchmark protocols](https://awesomecua.com/compare/benchmarks/) and [dataset profiles](https://awesomecua.com/compare/datasets/): source-reviewed specifications ([benchmarks JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/benchmarks-profiles.json), [datasets JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/datasets-profiles.json))
- [Reviewed paper BibTeX](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/citations.bib), [CSL JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/citations.csl.json) and [citation manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/citations-manifest.json)
- [Reviewed publication BibTeX](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/publication-citations.bib), [CSL JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/publication-citations.csl.json), [publication observations](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/publications.jsonl) and [their schema](https://awesomecua.com/schemas/publication-observation.schema.json): default arXiv citations keep the recorded preprint; publication editions use their own title, authors and date
- [Topic manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/topics.json): exact reviewed resource IDs, counts, subset URLs and SHA-256 fingerprints; each /downloads/topics/<topic>/ directory serves records.jsonl, citations.bib and citations.csl.json
- [Verified former repository names](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/repository-aliases.json) and [their schema](https://awesomecua.com/schemas/repository-alias.schema.json): use the canonical returned ID for retrieval upserts; aliases add no resources
- [Bilingual data hub](https://awesomecua.com/data/), [中文数据中心](https://awesomecua.com/zh/data/) and [download manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/manifest.json) ([schema](https://awesomecua.com/schemas/download-manifest.schema.json)): file paths, byte sizes, SHA-256 fingerprints, counts and units; compare catalog_sha256 across manifests before combining artifacts
- [Tagged data releases](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-CUA/releases): complete data bundles; verify SHA256SUMS and retain release-manifest.json, source_commit and catalog_sha256
- [Hugging Face dataset mirror](https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/AwesomeCUA): read-only Parquet and JSONL mirror of these downloads, one config per record type. metadata_only and github_candidates are unreviewed.
- [Computer-use agent survey](https://awesomecua.com/survey/): working manuscript with a separately frozen research inventory; not an additional catalog record
- [Survey bibliography](https://awesomecua.com/survey/references.bib)
- [Survey references JSON](https://awesomecua.com/survey/references.json)
- [Source reading register](https://awesomecua.com/survey/evidence/reading-index.json)
- [Survey file manifest](https://awesomecua.com/survey/build-manifest.json)
